newsitem.title: UK: Avon sees good demand in first half.
newsitem.headline: Avon sees good demand in first half.

text.p: British tyre maker Avon Rubber Plc said on Wednesday that demand for its core products in the automotive sector remained good both in Europe and North America and was expected to remain so at least through the first half of the current year.
Earlier, Avon reported a 33 percent rise in pre-tax profits in the year to September 28 to 21.5 million stg and boosted its total dividend payout 10.2 percent to 19.5 pence per share.
It said sales ot tyres in the UK and Europe remain at subdued levels but market conditions were favourable in the processed materials market.
"North American markets for our technical products generally remain encouraging but European demand has slowed," the company added in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
